title: What you may and may not transmit
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Amateur radio is for hams talking with hams. It is not for entertaining the public.
lines.label: ham to ham

lines.caption: So broadcasting, meaning transmissions for the general public, is not allowed.
lines.label: no broadcasting

lines.caption: Music is out too, except when it is part of an authorized relay of manned spacecraft communications.
lines.label: no music

lines.caption: Codes that hide your meaning are out, except commands sent to space stations and model craft.
lines.label: no secret codes

lines.caption: No pay for operating and no business. But you may mention ham gear for sale, now and then.
lines.label: no pay, no business

lines.caption: Now sort real situations into allowed and not allowed.
